title: Production-floor entry
passage:
What should we do before entering the production floor?
A. Put on protective footwear. B. The floor was cleaned this morning. C. We produced five hundred units.
passageZh:
進入生產現場前，我們應該做什麼？
A. 穿上防護鞋。
B. 地板今天早上清潔過了。
C. 我們生產了五百台。
audioScript:
What should we do before entering the production floor?
A. Put on protective footwear. B. The floor was cleaned this morning. C. We produced five hundred units.
